hypotheses.P0_three_sources_recompose_native_regist: All three exact pre-normalization sources reproduce the native context operator to relative error at most 1e-6.
hypotheses.P1_embedding_variation_is_a_strong_route: Direct Layer-17 embedding-reinjection variation alone retains at least 0.75 operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.P2_embedding_and_carried_state_are_nearl: Embedding plus carried-state variation retains at least 0.95 operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.P3_attention_is_a_small_operator_correct: The absolute three-source subset-Shapley allocation of final attention is at most 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P4_embedding_is_the_largest_shapley_sour: Embedding has the largest three-source subset-Shapley allocation on every corpus.
hypotheses.P5_attention_alone_is_not_a_router: Attention variation alone retains at most 0.25 operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.P6_carried_state_adds_beyond_embedding: Adding carried-state variation to embedding improves fidelity by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P7_embedding_dominance_transfers_ood: Embedding-only fidelity differs by at most 0.10 across FineWeb, WikiText, and TinyStories.
